description: This file is a C source file implementing the core logic for a transcode factory, managing transcoders and transcoder factories with thread safety, lookup functions, and registration mechanisms within a modular library. It includes functions for initialization, querying, transcoding operations, and registration of transcoders and factories.

methods.name: void cslt_init(icHashMap * transcoder_settings)
methods.description: Initializes the transcoder system with provided settings, creating the factory map, setting up supported transcoders, and ensuring thread safety via mutex.

methods.name: const cslt_factory_t * cslt_get_transcode_factory(const char * encoder)
methods.description: Retrieves a factory object for a given encoder name, returning NULL if not found, with thread safety.

methods.name: const cslt_transcoder_t * cslt_get_transcoder_by_name(const char * decoder,const char * encoder)
methods.description: Fetches a specific transcoder object based on decoder and encoder names, with validation and locking.

methods.name: const cslt_transcoder_t * cslt_get_transcoder(const cslt_factory_t * factory,const char * schema)
methods.description: Finds a transcoder within a factory that is valid for a given schema, using iteration and validation callbacks.

methods.name: int cslt_transcode_internal(const cslt_transcoder_t * transcoder,const char * src,char ** dst,size_t size)
methods.description: Performs the actual transcoding operation, validating inputs and invoking the transcoder's function, setting errno on failure.

methods.name: int cslt_transcode_preallocated(const cslt_transcoder_t * transcoder,const char * src,char * dst,size_t size)
methods.description: Transcodes with preallocated destination buffer, internally calls cslt_transcode_internal.

methods.name: int cslt_transcode(const cslt_transcoder_t * transcoder,const char * src,char ** dst)
methods.description: Transcodes with dynamic allocation, calling cslt_transcode_internal with default buffer size.

methods.name: int cslt_transcode_by_name_internal(const char * decoder,const char * encoder,const char * src,char ** dst,size_t size)
methods.description: Performs transcoding based on decoder and encoder names by resolving the appropriate transcoder.

methods.name: int cslt_transcode_by_name(const char * decoder,const char * encoder,const char * src,char ** dst)
methods.description: Transcodes by name, with dynamic output allocation.

methods.name: int cslt_transcode_by_name_preallocated(const char * decoder,const char * encoder,const char * src,char * dst,size_t size)
methods.description: Transcodes by name with preallocated output buffer.

methods.name: int cslt_transcode_by_schema_internal(const char * encoder,const char * src,char ** dst,size_t size)
methods.description: Performs transcoding based on an encoder and schema, resolving factory and transcoder accordingly.

methods.name: int cslt_transcode_by_schema(const char * encoder,const char * src,char ** dst)
methods.description: Wrapper for schema-based transcoding with dynamic output allocation.

methods.name: int cslt_transcode_by_schema_preallocated(const char * encoder,const char * src,char * dst,size_t size)
methods.description: Schema-based transcoding with preallocated output buffer.

methods.name: void cslt_register_factory(cslt_factory_t * factory)
methods.description: Registers a factory, adding it to the global factory map if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: void cslt_register_transcoder(const cslt_transcoder_t * transcoder)
methods.description: Registers a transcoder within the correct factory if not already registered.
